# U.S. Army (goarmy.com)

> Official U.S. Army recruitment and career exploration platform featuring Active Duty, Army Reserve, and Army National Guard service opportunities with detailed training and family support resources.

GoArmy.com serves as the primary digital hub for prospective soldiers and their families to explore military service options, understand training pathways, and access information about Army life, benefits, and career development across all service components.

## Key Topics

- Active Duty
- Army Reserve
- Army National Guard
- Military Occupation Specialty (MOS)
- Basic Combat Training
- Recruitment
- Military Service
- Career Paths
- Enlisted and Officer Roles
- Family Benefits
- Deployment
- Core Values
- Soldier Development
- 10th Mountain Division
- Military Training

## Service Components

- [Ways to Serve | U.S. Army](https://www.goarmy.com/explore-the-army/army-structure): Overview of three Army service components and commitment levels
- [Active Duty Service in the Army | U.S. Army](https://www.goarmy.com/explore-the-army/army-structure/active-duty): Active Duty service details with MOS and specialized skillset roles
- [Army Reserve | U.S. Army](https://www.goarmy.com/explore-the-army/army-structure/reserve): Part-time Army Reserve service with flexible civilian career balance
- [Army National Guard | U.S. Army](https://www.goarmy.com/explore-the-army/army-structure/national-guard): National Guard part-time service and state-based community defense

## About the Army

- [Be All You Can Be | U.S. Army](https://www.goarmy.com): Homepage exploring Active Duty, Army Reserve, and National Guard careers
- [About the Army | U.S. Army](https://www.goarmy.com/explore-the-army/about): Army mission, core values, and service opportunities overview
- [Purpose & Legacy | U.S. Army](https://www.goarmy.com/explore-the-army/about/purpose-legacy): Army heritage, core values, and U.S. Constitution-based purpose

## Training & Development

- [Basic Combat Training | U.S. Army](https://www.goarmy.com/army-life/basic-training): Basic Combat Training phases, tactics, and soldier development guide

## Army Life & Family

- [Family Life in the Army | U.S. Army](https://www.goarmy.com/army-life/family-living): Family benefits, housing, medical coverage, and readiness programs
- [Deployment | U.S. Army](https://www.goarmy.com/army-life/intro-to-army-life/deployment): Deployment guide with family support and veteran benefits resources

## Optional

- [Winter Sports | U.S. Army](https://www.goarmy.com/winter-sports): 10th Mountain Division legacy in winter sports and soldier-athletes
